results.text: Symptomatic Severe Bradycardia during Pazopanib Treatment. Pazopanib, a tyrosine kinase inhibitor that targets growth factor receptors, is associated with various side effects, including bradycardia. We report a severe case of symptomatic bradycardia, with a heart rate dropping to 28 beats per minute, in a patient with cardiac angiosarcoma treated with 800 mg/day of pazopanib.
